@kbench.task(name="learning_function_approx_14")
def learning_function_approx_14():
    """Learn function from input-output pairs."""
    prompt = """Unknown function f(x, y):

f(1, 1) = 2
f(2, 3) = 13
f(3, 2) = 11
f(4, 4) = 32

What is f(5, 3)?

A) 28
B) 30
C) 34
D) 38"""
    return prompt, "C"
